verdict.rationale: The 2FAS Auth browser extension, available for Chrome, Brave, Firefox, Edge, Opera and Safari, pairs with the phone and delivers TOTP tokens into the sign-in tab so the user doesn't have to retype them, after confirming each request in the mobile app. Nothing in the evidence shows passkey autofill, which is half of the story; 2FAS Pass autofill is documented only in general terms and not for passkeys. Missing for 10: passkey autofill support, details of how tokens are actually filled into login forms, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an everyday user, a browser extension autofills my TOTP codes and passkeys during login instead of making me retype them

citations.quote: Click the browser extension icon when you need to enter a 2FA token, then confirm in the mobile app. You don't have to retype anything.
The 2FAS Auth browser extension pairs with your phone to deliver 2FA tokens where you sign in — simple, private, and secure, without leaving the tab.
Add 2FAS Auth to your web browser by installing our extension for Chrome, Brave, Firefox, Edge, Opera and Safari.
